desc:
TURF 
Hold the line. Push the line. Take their turf.

Two teams, one field split down the middle. Every attack pushes the line into enemy territory, and you can't set foot on their side. Shrink their turf until they have nowhere left to stand.

BUILD - fortify your half with blocks before every fight
FIGHT - charge your bow, lead your shots, land headshots and collaterals
ESCALATE - Elims push the line 1 row in round 1, up to 5 rows by round 5

Push the line all the way for an instant win, or hold more turf after 5 rounds.

COMPETITIVE - Climb to the top in ranked 4v4 duels!
BOW SKINS - Open crates for Mythic and Secret skins with their own kill effects
Clans, parties, trading, leaderboards and a practice range

Works with VR, Console, PC, and Mobile!
